hanging_piece.title: Leaving pieces hanging
hanging_piece.what: After your move, a piece could be taken for free or by a cheaper piece.
hanging_piece.fix: Before you move, check every piece of yours: is it attacked, and is it defended?

missed_free_piece.title: Missing free pieces
missed_free_piece.what: You could win a piece for free, or with a cheaper piece, and played something else.
missed_free_piece.fix: Start every move by asking: what can I capture, and is it defended?

rushed.title: Moving too fast
rushed.what: A mistake or blunder played in under 3 seconds while you still had time.
rushed.fix: Take five seconds before each move to ask what your opponent's last move threatens.
